title: Order the Guard Clauses
story: Early returns keep code flat and readable. Put this function back together.
goal: Put the lines in order so the program prints B.
hints: The highest check comes first so a 95 never reaches the B rule.
The plain return "C" is the last line inside the function.
socratic: Why must the 90 check come before the 75 check?
What runs if neither if is true?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what decides the order of these lines?
